source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /collections/{c}/points/query -> query_points() -> convert_query_request_from_rest() -> query.map() -> try_into_shard_request() -> match query { None => scroll operation }
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: query参数为Option<QueryInterface>，显式允许None。当query=None时，源码在planned_query.rs:459-472处将其转换为scroll操作(按ID顺序返回点)。这是有明确注释的intentional design: 'If missing without prefetches, returns points ordered by their IDs.'

falsification.probe: Verify behavior with scroll operation and proper query
falsification.observed: When query=null, API performs scroll (returns all points ordered by ID, all score=1.0). When query={"nearest": [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]}, API performs vector search with scores. When query={}, API treats empty object as None (also scrolls). Behavior is consistent with documented design for missing/null query.

cognition_match.developer_quote: Lenient filter parsing: null / single-object / array forms are all accepted by design for filter condition fields (maintainers: 'This is fine and expected... it would be a breaking change'). Applies similarly to query parameter - None/null is accepted as intentional fallback to scroll.
cognition_match.note: 源码注释明确说明这是设计行为，开发者对可选参数采用lenient parsing策略

verdicts.rationale: POST /collections/{c}/points/query with query=null is NOT a parameter validation bug. 源码lib/api/src/rest/schema.rs:573明确注释: 'If missing without prefetches, returns points ordered by their IDs.' 源码lib/shard/src/query/planned_query.rs:459-472显式处理None query -> scroll操作。Contract定义query为required=false, type=object (nullable allowed by JSON schema)。这是intentional API设计: null/None query triggers scroll fallback, not an error case. 参见developer_cognition.json: maintainers对可选参数采用lenient parsing (null/single-object/array all accepted)。
